exposure: Clinical diagnosis of early neonatal death
outcome: Correlation between clinical diagnosis and autopsy findings
Types of discrepancies (full agreement, additional findings, changed diagnosis)
cohort: The participants were 27 cases of neonatal deaths that occurred within the first 7 days of life and underwent autopsy between 2006 and 2021.
finding: Post-mortem examinations frequently validate the clinical diagnosis of early neonatal deaths, but also reveal crucial additional information in nearly half of cases and change the primary diagnosis in a significant minority (11%).
followup_time: 7 days after birth (observation up to the point of death)
